faqs.question: What is FOM SD 25 used for?
faqs.answer: FOM SD 25 is a PEEK slot-die coating head used for precise, uniform, non-contact thin-film deposition at coating widths up to 25 mm, built specifically for harsh chemical or high-temperature coating conditions.

faqs.question: Why choose PEEK over stainless steel for a slot-die head?
faqs.answer: PEEK offers exceptional thermal stability, broad chemical resistance, and low-friction wear reduction, making it better suited than steel for aggressive solvents or elevated process temperatures.

faqs.question: What coating width does FOM SD 25 support?
faqs.answer: It supports coating widths from 1 to 25 mm, the narrowest standard format in the PEEK series.

faqs.question: What flatness tolerance does FOM SD 25 hold?
faqs.answer: It holds a flatness tolerance of ≤ 5 µm across its entire surface.

faqs.question: What viscosity range can FOM SD 25 handle?
faqs.answer: It handles viscosities from 1 cPs up to over 100,000 cPs at 25°C.

faqs.question: Can FOM SD 25 be used for double-sided coating?
faqs.answer: Yes, double-sided coating applications are supported on the FOM moduloR2R machine.

faqs.question: Is FOM SD 25 easy to disassemble and clean?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's engineered specifically for effortless disassembly, assembly, and cleaning.

faqs.question: Does FOM SD 25 work with a meniscus guide?
faqs.answer: Yes, the design works with or without a meniscus guide, adapting to different coating applications.

faqs.question: Are wider PEEK slot-die heads available?
faqs.answer: Yes, FOM Technologies offers the PEEK Series in wider formats, including SD 50, SD 100, and SD 200, alongside the full Steel Series.

body.text: Constructed from Polyetheretherketone (PEEK), the head delivers exceptional thermal stability, chemical resistance, and mechanical durability suited to harsh coating environments.

Exceptional thermal resistance lets the head withstand high temperatures encountered during coating without significant degradation.
High chemical resistance across a wide range of chemistries makes the head suitable for use with varied, aggressive coating materials.
Low friction characteristics reduce wear and frictional losses during coating, extending operational life and minimizing maintenance requirements.
A standard single manifold and a 1/2-20 UNF thread for tube connections come built into the head.
Lip protection on the slot-die supports a self-standing feature, aiding manufacturing processes.
The design works with or without a meniscus guide, adapting to different coating applications.
Custom shim and meniscus guide designs are supported, with precise FOM alignment design keeping shim and guide positioning reliable.
Double-sided coating applications are supported on the FOM moduloR2R machine.
A lightweight, high-quality protective flight case ships with the head for shipping and storage.

paragraphs: Some coating formulations are simply too aggressive, too hot, or too chemically demanding for standard stainless steel to handle reliably over repeated use. PEEK construction is FOM's answer to that specific problem.

Exceptional thermal resistance lets FOM SD 25 withstand the high temperatures encountered during coating processes without significant degradation, keeping performance consistent even under demanding thermal conditions. That pairs with broad chemical resistance across a wide range of chemistries, making the head suitable for aggressive coating materials that would otherwise shorten a standard head's usable life. Low friction characteristics work alongside both, reducing wear and frictional losses during coating, which directly extends operational life and keeps maintenance requirements minimized over time.

body: How FOM SD 25's self-standing design and lightweight construction simplify daily handling.
A slot-die head that's difficult to disassemble or clean adds friction to every changeover, and FOM SD 25 is engineered specifically to remove that friction.

Lip protection on the slot-die supports a self-standing feature, making the head easier to handle and set down safely during manufacturing without needing a dedicated stand at every step. The design is engineered for effortless disassembly, assembly, and cleaning, and works with or without a meniscus guide depending on what a given coating application requires. A protective flight case ships with the head, keeping it protected during shipping and storage between uses, and an integrated pressure gauge enhances functionality directly on the unit.

body: How FOM SD 50's self-standing design and lightweight construction simplify daily handling.
A slot-die head that's difficult to disassemble or clean adds friction to every changeover, and FOM SD 50 is engineered specifically to remove that friction, even at its wider format.

Lip protection on the slot-die supports a self-standing feature, making the head easier to handle and set down safely during manufacturing without needing a dedicated stand at every step. The design is engineered for effortless disassembly, assembly, and cleaning, and works with or without a meniscus guide depending on what a given coating application requires. A protective flight case ships with the head, keeping it protected during shipping and storage between uses, and an integrated pressure gauge enhances functionality directly on the unit.

High chemical resistance across a wide range of chemistries makes the head suitable for use with varied, aggressive coating materials.
Low friction characteristics reduce wear and frictional losses during coating, extending operational life and minimizing maintenance requirements.
A standard single manifold and a 1/2-20 UNF thread for tube connections come built into the head.
Lip protection on the slot-die supports a self-standing feature, aiding manufacturing processes.
The design works with or without a meniscus guide, adapting to different coating applications.
Custom shim and meniscus guide designs are supported, with precise FOM alignment design keeping shim and guide positioning reliable.

A lightweight, high-quality protective flight case ships with the head for shipping and storage.

faqs.question: What is the FOM SD 200 used for?
faqs.answer: It's a PEEK slot-die coating head for precision coating in harsh conditions, coating widths from 1 to 200 mm across applications including solar cells, OLEDs, batteries, membranes, and printed electronics.

faqs.question: What coating width does it support?
faqs.answer: 1 to 200 mm.

faqs.question: What viscosity range can it handle?
faqs.answer: From 1 cPs to more than 100,000 cPs at 25 °C — thin solutions through to highly viscous slurries.

faqs.question: What is the flatness tolerance?
faqs.answer: ≤ 5 µm, achieved over the entire inside plane surface of the slot-die.

faqs.question: Why is the head made from PEEK?
faqs.answer: Polyetheretherketone delivers exceptional thermal stability, high chemical resistance across a wide range of coating materials, mechanical durability, and low friction characteristics that reduce wear.

faqs.question: Can it be used with aggressive solvents?
faqs.answer: Yes. PEEK is highly resistant to a wide range of chemicals, making the slot-die suitable for use with varied and aggressive coating materials.

faqs.question: How does it handle high process temperatures?
faqs.answer: Exceptional thermal resistance allows it to withstand the high temperatures encountered during coating processes without significant degradation.

faqs.question: Are shims and meniscus guides customizable?
faqs.answer: Yes. Custom shim and meniscus guide designs are available, and the head works with or without a meniscus guide depending on the application.

faqs.question: How is the shim positioned accurately on reassembly?
faqs.answer: The FOM alignment design facilitates precise, reliable positioning of both the shim and the meniscus guide.

faqs.question: How easy is it to clean between formulations?
faqs.answer: The head is engineered specifically for effortless disassembly, assembly, and cleaning.

faqs.question: Does the head include pressure monitoring?
faqs.answer: Yes. An integrated pressure gauge is built into the head.

faqs.question: What tube connection does it use?
faqs.answer: A 1/2-20 UNF thread for connecting tubes.

faqs.question: Can it be used for double-sided coating?
faqs.answer: Yes, for double-sided coating applications on the FOM moduloR2R machine.

faqs.question: Does it stand on its own during handling?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lip protection on the slot-die supports a self-standing feature, aiding manufacturing and handling processes.

faqs.question: What is supplied with the head?
faqs.answer: A lightweight, high-quality protective flight case for shipping and storage.

faqs.question: How does FOM SD 200 differ from the other PEEK series heads?
faqs.answer: Width is the primary difference — SD 25, SD 50, SD 100, and SD 200 correspond to maximum coating widths of 25, 50, 100, and 200 mm. All share PEEK construction, custom shim and meniscus guide options, and the same design approach.

Flatness on the inside planes holds to 5 µm or better across the entire surface — the specification that determines whether a coating bead stays uniform across the full width or thins toward the edges. Machined from PEEK, it brings three properties that matter in aggressive chemistry: thermal stability that withstands high coating temperatures without significant degradation, chemical resistance across a wide range of coating materials, and low friction that reduces wear and extends operational life. sections.tabSummary: What 1 cPs to 100,000 cPs and 5 µm flatness deliver
body: What five orders of viscosity and 5 µm flatness deliver in practice.

Formulation work rarely stays in one viscosity band, and most heads force a second purchase when it moves. FOM SD 200 covers 1 cPs to more than 100,000 cPs at 25 °C on a single head, so dilute precursors and heavy slurries run through the same component without a second alignment or cleaning procedure.

Precision comes from manufacturing tolerance. Flatness on the inside planes holds to 5 µm or better across the entire surface, not at selected measurement points, and that is what keeps the coating bead uniform across the full width rather than thinning toward the edges. Coating width runs from 1 mm for narrow trials up to 200 mm for pilot-relevant formats, with a standard single manifold distributing flow and an integrated pressure gauge showing what the head is actually experiencing during a run.

paragraphs: PEEK is chosen for three properties working together. Thermal stability lets the head withstand the high temperatures encountered during coating without significant degradation, and chemical resistance across a wide range of coating materials makes it suitable for aggressive solvent systems that would attack other constructions.

The third property is the least obvious and the most operationally useful. Low friction characteristics reduce wear and frictional losses during coating, which translates directly into longer operational life and less maintenance intervention over the head's working life. Mechanical durability holds the structure through repeated assembly, disassembly, and cleaning cycles, which is why FOM positions the PEEK series for precision coating in harsh conditions specifically rather than as a general-purpose option.
